primary_sources.title: LeetCode 143 — Reorder List
claims: The input is a singly linked list L0 -> L1 -> ... -> Ln.
The required output order is L0 -> Ln -> L1 -> Ln-1 -> L2 -> Ln-2 -> ... .
Node values must not be modified; the nodes themselves must be reordered by changing links.
The observed official constraints include 1 <= number of nodes <= 5 * 10^4 and 1 <= Node.val <= 1000.

reproducible_checks.coverage: official odd/even examples, single/two/three-node boundaries, duplicate-value identity-sensitive case, and generated lengths 1..64 checked against an independent array-order oracle with cycle, count, node-identity, and value-preservation assertions
